findingClass: a non-terminal ipo_field_plan row (NOT_AVAILABLE_YET or CHECK_FAILED) that is reclaimable in principle but has gone 2+ discovery slots unclaimed — the class #762 found: claimNextDueField shipped as state='PENDING' only and left 12,480 such rows permanently unasked with zero PENDING rows anywhere
whatItAsks: every non-terminal, below-attempts-ceiling, currently-unclaimed plan row has a last_attempt_at within the last ~2 discovery slots (7h) — a longer gap means the claim query has stopped reclaiming that state
scope: phase-1 IPOs, MAINBOARD + SME, prod + staging slots; state IN (NOT_AVAILABLE_YET, CHECK_FAILED), attempts < FIELD_PLAN_RECLAIM_MAX_ATTEMPTS, claimed_at IS NULL
consumerReason: a stuck reclaim is a per-cycle structural fact about the claim query, read by row identity each run — the same consumer as pull_plan_rank, which this check is a sibling of
